# package fxdataid

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uafx/fxdataid"
```

Package fxdataid holds the numeric identifiers of the nodes of the UAFX Data information model of OPC 10000-81 (opc.ua.fx.data.nodeset2 of the OPC Foundation), generated from schema/opc.ua.fx.data.nodeset2.csv by go generate (internal/cmd/gen).

The identifiers belong to the namespace NamespaceURI. Its namespace index differs from server to server: resolve it with the NamespaceArray of the server, for example ua.NewNumericNodeID(ns, fxdataid.FxRoot).

## Constants

```go
const NamespaceURI = "http://opcfoundation.org/UA/FX/Data/"
```

NamespaceURI is the namespace of the UAFX Data information model.
